title: Sources: amid leak fears, Anthropic limited some IPO banks to four-person teams, used a view-logging file platform, and sought six-month bans on advising rivals (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: amid leak fears, Anthropic limited some IPO banks to four-person teams, used a view-logging file platform, and sought six-month bans on advising rivals — For the second time this year, Wall Street bankers and lawyers took home a massive paycheck from a record-setting initial public offering.
